name: MONTANA COMMERCIAL SAUNA
description:
The 2019 Montana commercial sauna is designed so you may recline fully or seat 5 adults comfortably. 52 square feet of Zero EMF Rated Nano-Carbon™ infrared panels provide total body exposure and maximum health results.

Extra thick walls for durability, 3400 watt output, full flush floor infrared heaters, 30 hour programmable timer, Chromotherapy lights, oxygen ionizer, and integrated Bluetooth stereo are all Standard Equipment. All Rocky Mountain Saunas commercial models are designed for high traffic Fitness Center use, but are also quite popular in home gym settings. Montana Sauna shown above is with Cedar wood.

Black plexi-glass trim décor is not included on the side walls, but is only installed on the front panel, on either side of the door.
